# JobPilot

JobPilot is a personalized, mostly-automated job-search pipeline. It builds a canonical
Master CV from the user's own artifacts, finds fresh high-fit roles, tailors materials,
and drafts targeted outreach — optimized for fit and quality per application, not volume.

## What it does

- Builds a source-grounded Master CV where every claim traces to exact evidence.
- Scores and re-ranks fresh job postings against the approved CV nightly.
- Detects interview invitations with verified provenance before anything is stored.
